notes.title: The new update will come out soon!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We glad to say that new update with a lot of crazy changes is coming out!
In firstly we want to say thanks for all your support and feedbacks on steam!
We happy to say that we made new Arcade mode instead of boring arenas where you will fight your enemies with the new awesome graphic that we will bring to you in our game in the new update!
We made new sounds, new effects, haptic feedback in controllers to get a better sword-fight experience.
And most important that we seriously improved gameplay, you will meet new types of enemies with different animations and tactics, we reworked balance in the fights and much more to get best engaging sword fights.
Here is a little showcase of upcoming graphics : )

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31734603/35148c9593290e07dd60d3b22c39ead026eaf0c3.png[/img]

Also, you can track the progress of Zanshin on my twitter!
https://twitter.com/Alexandr_Rice

Best regards,
Alexander Rice.
